title: "U-2 photography of Tyuratam Missile Testing Range" (Chapter 3, p. 137)
description: Dark black-and-white U-2 aerial reconnaissance photograph of the Tyuratam launch complex, showing a launch pad area with converging roads and rail lines. Captioned "U-2 photography of Tyuratam Missile Testing Range." The text explains the name Tyuratam versus the official Soviet name Baykonur and the August 1957 Soviet ICBM launch announcement.
